title: Symrise launches digital platform on CO₂ tracking and reinforces its bioeconomy commitment at COP30
summary: – Contributing to COP30 focusing on biodiversity and circularity – Advancing data-driven climate action with partners by launching ‘Houston’ a greenhouse gas emissions tracking platform – Entering the global bioeconomy dialogue with a co-chair function

extraction.key_fact: 심라이즈가 온실가스 배출 추적을 위한 디지털 플랫폼 휴스턴을 출시하며 기후 행동 및 바이오경제에 대한 의지를 강화했다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: Symrise launches digital platform on CO₂ tracking and reinforces its bioeconomy commitment at COP30
